interface.signature: def biGraph(n: int, e: int, arr: list[int]) -> int:

preconditions.expression: n >= 2 and e >= 1 and e <= 100 and n <= 100 and len(arr) == 2 * e
preconditions.description: Input constraints: n is the number of vertices (2 ≤ n ≤ 100), e is the number of edges (1 ≤ e ≤ 100), and arr is a list of 2*e integers representing undirected edges.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < n and 0 <= v < n for u, v in zip(arr[::2], arr[1::2]))
preconditions.description: All edge pairs (u, v) in arr are valid vertex indices within the range [0, n-1].

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if (n == 2 or (n > 2 and all(len(neighbors) > 1 for neighbors in adjacency_list))) and is_biconnected(adjacency_list) else 0
postconditions.description: Returns 1 if the graph is biconnected (no articulation points and connected), else returns 0. A graph is biconnected if it remains connected after the removal of any single vertex.
